name: Fluff Hood's Adventure
source:
This is (kind of) a Little Red Riding Hood version of Togainu No Chi. Fluff Hood (Akira) was sent to deliver cookies to the Toshima forest, met lots of weirdos and discovered something surprising.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28716]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是《咎狗之血》的小红帽版本（大致如此）。Fluff Hood（明）被派去向丰岛森林送饼干，途中遇见许多怪人，还发现了令人震惊的事情。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28716]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
